# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-5291

# Review — PAN-5291
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — CI `lint-group (core)` is red on HEAD: `lint:harness-branches` rejects the two new header files

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-5291-review-9765ab0f
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5291/.pan/review/agent-pan-5291-review-9765ab0f/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-5291 / /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5291
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5333 (headRefOid 9765ab0ff683)
- HEAD reviewed: 9765ab0ff683f2bcbfc96bdf6703df5496dfc4c4
- Base (merge-base with origin/main): eeeb0a78116; no prior review cycle

## Blocking Findings

### [correctness] Moved harness-name branches fail the CI harness-branch ratchet — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/header/ConversationHeader.tsx:151`, `ConversationHeaderMenu.tsx:267,307`
- Severity: ! (MUST)
- Classification / scope: implementation defect, in_pr_scope (introduced by WI-1 commit b37f49df901).
- Trigger and changed-code connection: WI-1 moved four `conversation.harness === '<name>'` comparisons out of `ConversationPanel.tsx` (baseline row `4 …/chat/ConversationPanel.tsx`) into two new files: the Pi abort check (`harness === 'ohmypi' || harness === 'pi'`) in `ConversationHeader.tsx`, and `harness !== 'pi'` (summary fork) plus `harness === 'claude-code'` (delivery row) in `ConversationHeaderMenu.tsx`. `scripts/lint-harness-branches.sh` fails any file with a match and no row in `scripts/harness-branches-baseline.txt`. The committed baseline at HEAD has no rows for the new files.
- Expected / observed / impact: expected all required CI checks green. Observed on 9765ab0f: `lint-group (core)` = fail and the aggregate `lint` = fail. Log (job 132766387254):
  ```
  ✖ src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/header/ConversationHeader.tsx: NEW file with 2 harness-name branches
  ✖ src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/header/ConversationHeaderMenu.tsx: NEW file with 2 harness-name branches
  Replace the branch with a HarnessCapabilities field — see configuration/harnesses.mdx "Harness capabilities".
  ```
  The PR cannot merge while this check is red. The local verification gate (`overdeck/test`: typecheck + lint) passed, so the local lint did not run this guard.
- Evidence: `gh pr checks 5333` and the failed-job log above. The working tree contains an **uncommitted** edit to `scripts/harness-branches-baseline.txt` (removes the panel row, adds `2` rows for both header files). That edit is not part of the reviewed HEAD, so it is not evidence of a fix. With that edit present, the local guard prints `✓ harness-branch ratchet passed (200 in 74 files; none new)`.
- Fix: do one of these and push, then let CI re-run:
  1. Commit the baseline move: delete the `4 …/chat/ConversationPanel.tsx` row and add `2 …/chat/header/ConversationHeader.tsx` and `2 …/chat/header/ConversationHeaderMenu.tsx`. The total stays at 4. Adding a row is a hand edit, so `scripts/lint-ratchet-audit.sh` requires an issue reference such as `PAN-5291` in that commit message.
  2. Or replace the comparisons with `HarnessCapabilities` fields, as the guard suggests. This is the larger change. Option 1 matches a no-behavior-change extraction.

## Non-blocking Findings

### [correctness] The favorite-editor shortcut no longer falls back to the server's default cwd — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/header/ConversationHeader.tsx:72`
- Severity: ? (MAY). Specification choice: the code follows PRD D1-5 verbatim.
- Trigger: a local conversation row with no `cwd`. Before, the status-line picker registered ⌘⇧O with `openInCwd ?? defaultCwd`. Now the hook gets `null` and registers nothing. The ⋯ → Open folder items still fall back to `defaultCwd`, so the two entry points disagree only in this rare case.

### [performance] More `/changes` traffic inside a Stage — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/header/headerChanges.tsx:31`
- Severity: ? (MAY). As specified in D1-8.
- Each visible conversation pane in a Stage now holds the `/changes` query and an explorer watch for its root. Before, only an open dock did. `useConversationChanges` invalidates on every watch batch without its own throttle. Stage renders only the layout leaves (`Stage/index.tsx` `PaneLayoutView`), so the load is bounded by the number of split panes (usually 1–4). React Query dedupes per key. No material impact is shown.

### [simplification] `ConversationStatusLine` declares and receives a `native` prop that it does not use — `ConversationStatusLine.tsx:27`
- Severity: ?. Harmless.

### [stub-ui scanner] The three `useState(false)` hits are false positives
- `ConversationHeader.tsx:73` `menuOpen`: set by the ⋯ trigger and the header `onContextMenu`. `:75` `editingTitle`: set by `startEditingTitle`. `ConversationHeaderMenu.tsx:90` `deliveryMethodSaving`: set around the delivery-method POST.

## Coverage

### Changed-file ledger
| File | Status |
|---|---|
| chat/header/ConversationHeader.tsx (new) | Read in full. Faithful move of the title, rename, retitle, abort and menu-open state. Stage gate is `useStageDeck()?.openDock`. Shortcut hook stays mounted. Harness branches: see blocker. |
| chat/header/ConversationHeaderMenu.tsx (new) | Read in full and compared with the base menu line by line. Every old item keeps its action and condition. Order matches D1-3. Native gating matches (groups 3–5 and Archive hidden; view toggles, copy and open-in-new-window visible). The Advanced group renders only with the delivery row. Stop the agent has no confirm. |
| chat/header/ConversationStatusLine.tsx (new) | Read in full. Parts are in D1-10 order, use singular forms and hide zero counts. They are buttons only inside a Stage. The `abbreviateHome` regex matches D1-11. |
| chat/header/headerChanges.tsx (new) | Read in full. Reuses `useConversationChanges(conv,'conversation',…)`, which shares the cache key. Disabled for id<0, linked and vault. Buttons open and never toggle. aria and title text follow D1-13/14. |
| chat/header/OpenFolderMenuItems.tsx (new) | Read in full. The preferred editor is first and shows the shortcut. Linked lists REMOTE_EDITORS, then the disabled REMOTE_UNVERIFIED. Launch helpers are shared. Mounted only while the menu is open. |
| components/PanOpenInPicker.tsx | Read the diff. Extracts `useAvailableEditors`, `openFolderInEditor`, `openLinkedFolderInEditor`. Picker behavior for the other consumers is unchanged. |

It drops "Archive conversation" from WI-11 step 3, which is justified: `AgentPane` passes no `onArchived` (verified). Not executed here; the PR body reports 5/5 against an isolated build. |
| tests/hide-tool-calls.spec.ts, tests/pan-4497-timeline-overlap.spec.ts | Read the diffs: they use ⋯ → Show tool calls. Neither is in CI's `test:playwright` list. Not executed here. |
| Stale-label sweep | `grep` over `src/dashboard/frontend/{src,tests}` for the old labels (Show/Hide bookmarks, Show/Hide about, Copy link to conversation, Detach conversation, `title="Hide tool calls"`, MoreVertical, conversationSessionId) found no stale header reference. The remaining "Stop agent" hits are issue-action/row menus, not this header. No CI Playwright spec drives this header. |
| scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt | 4 additions in sorted position. The disorder at StaleBuildChip predates this PR. |
| docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md, features/conversations.mdx, changelog.d/pan-5291.md | Read the diffs. WI-12 greps: no header `⋮` remains; "Copy session id", "Advanced → Delivery method", "⋯ → **Bookmarks**" and "Stop the agent" are present. |
| docs/screenshots/pan-5291/*.png | Viewed both. Dark and light match D1-2/D1-10: Changes +10 −1, Files, ⋯; folder, branch, 1 commit pushed, 1 commit not pushed, amber 1 file not committed. Cost is absent in the fixture; `--signal-cost-foreground` exists in `index.css` (light and dark), and `.eyebrow` exists. |
| .pan/drafts, .pan/specs, .pan/continues | Planning artifacts; read the PRD §1–§10 for the requirements. No runtime effect. |

### Dimensions
- **Correctness:** one blocker (CI ratchet). Otherwise the moved handlers match the base, and the new effects are guarded against stale and mount-time triggers.
- **Security:** no new trust boundary and no server/API change. Requests reuse existing routes and headers. Clipboard writes only the name, session id and URL.
- **Performance:** no new polling. Bounded extra `/changes` and watch load inside a Stage, as specified (advisory above). The editors RPC now runs per menu open, which is negligible.
- **Requirements/UX:** see the AC matrix.

### Acceptance criteria (PRD §8)
| AC | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| AC-1 extraction | Met | Panel 1033 lines; the three files exist; WI-1 commit b37f49df901 touches no test file. |
| AC-2 Changes/Files + Stage gate | Met | headerChanges.test (+86 −1, aria, openDock inputs, no request for id<0 or linked); panel tests inside and outside a Stage with the strict fetch mock. |
| AC-4 view toggles in ⋯ | Met | Panel tests; menuitemcheckbox + aria-checked; trigger label kept; "Stop the agent" in the native test. |
| AC-5 copy / open in new window | Met | Panel tests (Open in new window, copy ids, session id condition, no session id text). |
| AC-6 open folder + shortcut | Met | OpenFolderMenuItems.test; panel shortcut test; native test (no items in the phone app); picker tests pass in CI shards. |
| AC-7 subagents toggle | Met | SubagentRail toggleSignal tests (mount, flip, defaultCollapsed, narrow); panel test. |
| AC-8 status line | Met | ConversationStatusLine.test (order, actions, amber class, zero counts, outside Stage). |
| AC-9 chip resync | Met | ConversationChangesList.test "moves the chip … while the list stays mounted". |
| AC-10 spec updates | Met | Diffs; no `title="Hide/Show tool calls"` remains. |
| AC-11 header spec + screenshots | Met per the PR's report (5/5); not re-run here | Spec read; both PNGs exist and are embedded in the PR body. |
| AC-12 docs | Met (lint:docs not run locally; Mintlify check skipped) | Greps above. |
| NFR-5 quality gates | **Unmet** | CI `lint-group (core)` fails (blocker). |

Non-goals checked: no diff to ComposerFooter, Stage, src/lib, server, packages or the file-size allowlist. The ⋯ aria-label is unchanged, Stop has no confirm, and the rail default is unchanged.

## Verification
- `npx vitest run` on the 8 touched test files: **8 files, 126 tests passed**.
- `npm run lint:effect-diagnostics`: **passed** (227 known findings; none new).
- `overdeck/verification` gate (`overdeck/test`): passed (typecheck + lint; tests deferred to CI).
- CI on PR #5333 at 9765ab0f (checked again just before signaling): test shards 1–4, test-e2e, build, the effect/skills/state lint groups, mobile-android and the integrations job **pass**. **`lint-group (core)` and `lint` fail** (harness-branch ratchet, above).
- Playwright specs were not executed here.
- The full test suite was not run (per role).

## Scope Note
The workspace has uncommitted edits to `scripts/harness-branches-baseline.txt` and `.pan/continues/PAN-5291.xbrief.json`. They appeared after the review started, probably from a concurrent work-agent session. This review evaluates only the committed HEAD 9765ab0f. The fix must be committed, with an issue reference in the message, and pushed before the next review cycle.
